B1.1.name: simple atomic recall
B1.1.description: Each step is independent and fully specified.

B1.2.name: immediate context
B1.2.description: Each step depends on the previous one.
B1.2.hint_example: Select the seat for the flight you just chose.

B1.3.name: long context
B1.3.description: Each step depends on the entire procedure.
B1.3.hint_example: Ensure total transfer amount matches your monthly limit.

B1.4.name: cross session
B1.4.description: Step depends on past sessions, documents, or external tools.
B1.4.hint_example: Recreate your last year’s travel route for comparison.

B2.1.name: conditinal task
B2.1.hint_example: If weather forecast is bad, reschedule the flight

B2.2.name: Iterative task
B2.2.hint_example: Search for available flights until a match is found.

B3.1.name: transfert learning
B3.1.description: Transfert learning to similar but yet different task.
B3.1.hint_example: Adapt the loan approval workflow for student loans

B3.2.name: constraint or impossibily
B3.2.description: Learning under contraint or impossibility (e.g. tool unavailable).
B3.2.hint_example: Attempt to assemble parts from incompatible or inexisting kits.
